        return 0
    j = 1
    cnt = 1
    while j <= n:
        j = j * 10 + 1
        cnt += 1
    cnt -= 1
    j = (j - 1) // 10
    if j == n:
        return cnt
    best = 1 << 29
    if j * 10 + 1 - n < n:

    i = 1
    best2 = 0
    while j * i <= n:
        best2 = j * i
        i += 1
    return min(solve(n - best2) + cnt * (i - 1), best)
